subtopics.title: Post-Training Workflow
subtopics.summary: The overall sequence of pre-training, supervised finetuning (SFT), and preference finetuning (e.g., RLHF) used to align a foundation model with user intent.

subtopics.title: Supervised Finetuning (SFT)
subtopics.summary: Training a pre-trained model on labeled conversational data to convert text-completion behavior into instruction-following dialogue.

subtopics.title: Preference Finetuning
subtopics.summary: Aligning model outputs with human preferences using methods such as RLHF, since preferences cannot be captured by a single mathematical formula.

subtopics.title: Parameter-Efficient Finetuning
subtopics.summary: Adapter-based techniques such as LoRA and PEFT that reduce compute and memory requirements compared to full finetuning.

subtopics.title: Finetuning Frameworks and Tactics
subtopics.summary: Practical tools like LLaMA-Factory, PEFT, and Axolotl, along with tactics such as model merging, multi-task finetuning, and full finetuning.
